name: LAMMPS molecule
description: Full/real topology atoms, explicit bonds and the physical simulation cell, with optional complete text-dump frames.

bindings.name: data
bindings.description: Verified collected case directory or another local directory holding the explicit topology and trajectory files.

graph.name: LAMMPS molecule
graph.description: Sphere atoms with original IDs, types and charges; only data-file bonds; no inferred connectivity or volume probe.

parameters.name: topology
parameters.label: Topology file
parameters.description: Relative full/real LAMMPS data file inside the data binding.

parameters.name: trajectory
parameters.label: Trajectory file
parameters.description: Relative complete text dump, or empty for the static topology. Duplicate or backward timesteps are rejected.

parameters.name: step
parameters.label: Timestep
parameters.description: An exact available dump timestep, first or latest.

parameters.name: wrapped_display
parameters.label: Wrap periodic display
parameters.description: Display convention only; original coordinates remain in source_position. Static data does not encode periodic boundaries.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.label: Atom display radius (angstrom)
parameters.description: Visual radius, not an atomic or van der Waals radius.
